comment: Written from the maker's source at commit 5ebe71e, the last of the three commits whose plugin.json carries 2.1.6.0; the installed manifest's authorUrl, 'https://linktr.ee/michelezac', matches 9d79d54 and 5ebe71e rather than the earlier a903f08, and no DSP file differs between any of those three or the repository head. The DSP is written in Vult and compiled to C++; CrossSeq2.vult is the readable form and CrossSeq2.cpp the generated one. The panel prints only the row labels rt, am, sh, ph and pw, with the left column belonging to LFO 1 and the right to LFO 2; the individual knobs carry no lettering. The freq input is the only CV input with no attenuverter, and it is the only one added at full voltage rather than divided by ten. Nothing in the module clamps the master frequency, so a negative freq input drives the phase increment negative, and the phase wrap in lfo_interp only wraps downward from above 2.0.
